result.summary: Confirmed clean working tree on feature/WF02-REQ038-20260817 (commit da3a3bd, up to date with origin) and Postgres reachable (letflow-postgres-1, healthy, port 5462) before running. Ran `mix test` (full suite) twice from a cold start: run 1 unpinned/random seed 746756 -> 'Result: 647 passed (4 properties, 643 tests)', exit 0, Finished in 58.2s; run 2 pinned seed 0 -> identical 'Result: 647 passed (4 properties, 643 tests)', exit 0, Finished in 58.9s. Both raw logs (14,806 and 14,760 lines respectively, captured in full) grepped with a failure-marker regex (Failures:/Failure:/** (/Excluded:/Skipped:/ failure[s]?,/failed)) excluding the '0 failures' summary phrasing and the known pre-existing OIDC placeholder-issuer error noise -- zero matches in either run. Ran `mix test test/letflow/definitions/rollback_test.exs` in isolation a third time: 'Result: 18 passed', exit 0, seed 751292, Finished in 5.0s -- exactly matches TEST-DESIGNER's and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's independently-confirmed 18-test count. Count arithmetic cross-checked: task-cited baseline 629 passed (4 properties, 625 tests) on main + 18 new REQ-038 tests = 647 passed (4 properties, 643 tests) -- matches both full-suite runs exactly, zero regressions. Investigated all compiler-warning noise in the logs (10 warnings: 4x register_test/4 deprecated, 3x unused default-arg warnings including two 'start_pool!/1' warnings, 1x redefined-migration-module warning, 2x set-theoretic-type-checker warnings in registry_test.exs:654 and near snapshot_store_test.exs) via `git diff main...HEAD --stat` and `git log --oneline -1` on each source file -- confirmed none of the five warning-source files were touched by this branch (this branch's 16-file diff only touches docs/issues/ISS-0038.yaml, handoffs/WF02-REQ038-20260817/*, lib/letflow/definitions.ex, lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store.ex, lib/letflow/design/req038-promotion-rollback.md, test/letflow/definitions/rollback_test.exs, test/specs/REQ-038.md); all five are pre-existing compiler-time diagnostics local to unrelated files' own code, not errors/skips/failures. No pre-existing failure found anywhere in the suite -- Unblock-Everything: N/A, nothing to unblock. ISSUE_QUEUE protocol: N/A, nothing new to file this step -- ISS-0038 (moduledoc stale-arity drift in promotion_review_store.ex, MINOR) was already filed upstream by REVIEWER at Step 2d, not by this step, and is unrelated to any test failure (there were none). Wrote test/reports/report-2026-08-18-WF02-REQ038-20260817.yaml following the REQ-031 report's format, with full verbatim summary/finished lines, seeds, exit codes, and the noise investigation documented in full for audit-trail honesty.
